source_state: base plus Tight security-envelope/vendor UTF-8 patch and protected-RDP probe in the same commit as this record
build: Windows x64 debug; headless SessionManager probes, not native GUI acceptance

fixture.transport: authorized private LAN; source-specific server ACL

results.case: Tight envelope and vendor UTF-8 capability negotiation
results.scope: one complete-screen smoke observation, not a benchmark median

results.case: real Windows clipboard Unicode both directions
results.method: send a synthetic PowerShell expression via VNC clipboard; paste and execute in the real console; Set-Clipboard emits a distinct resulting marker; receive marker and exact Unicode payload through VNC
results.scope: real OS clipboard, not echo; one end-to-end run; clipboard permissions and empty/malformed boundaries also covered by wire/Linux tests

results.method: observe secure desktop over VNC, approve elevation with keyboard, verify administrator token from elevated shell
results.scope: authorized fixture only; not Ctrl+Alt+Del acceptance

results.method: lock workstation from shell; observe lock/login screen; enter protected test password as key events after stable focus; submit separately; confirm restored elevated desktop
results.scope: Win+L shortcut was not accepted as evidence; native Windows key hook and IME remain open

results.method: save password directly to isolated v2 vault, discard instance, reload locked, reject wrong master without changing file, unlock, use stored credential for real RDP authentication, complete framebuffer, relock and close
results.scope: headless production SessionManager path; native vault settings/dialog interaction remains open

limitations: Not the full Windows performance/weak-network matrix.
UltraVNC is not covered by this record.
No native 100/150/200-percent DPI, system shortcut, AltGr, IME, suspend or physical network-switch acceptance.
Tight vendor UTF-8 is a separate negotiated extension; a classic CutText endpoint is not assumed to carry Unicode.
Screenshots, host addresses, account names, passwords and authentication bytes intentionally excluded.

regressions.linux_real_clipboard: TigerVNC modern UTF-8 and legacy Latin-1: 2/2 passed; see independent real-server suite
